flows.title: Create a job
steps: In Greenhouse Recruiting, click the Add button at the top of the page and select Create a Job from the drop-down menu.
Select Copy an Existing Job, Sample Job or Blank Job.
Complete the steps of the job setup flow, then click Finish. The job's dashboard opens.
If the job needs approval before it opens, click Request Approval in the job page's navigation bar. Until then it is a Draft.

flows.title: Add a candidate
steps: In Greenhouse Recruiting, hover over Add at the top of the page and click Add a Candidate.
Select the Job for the candidate and, if needed, the Initial Stage.
Enter the candidate's information; required fields are marked with an asterisk. Dragging their resume into the top left corner fills in some fields automatically.
Upload any documents at the bottom of the page, then click Add this candidate.

flows.title: Add a prospect
steps: In Greenhouse Recruiting, hover over Add at the top of the page and click Add a Candidate.
Select the Prospect tab at the top of the page. A prospect has not applied, and can be added to several jobs, departments or offices.
Fill in the details the same way as for a candidate, then click Add this candidate.
